xian-2014.notes: Source 1: earlier reader read a different (2019) copy; current copy is a 2014 notice page, roles corrected to web. Sources 3 and 6 have no copy. Scoreboard (264 rows) mixes in rows beyond the 253 ranked official teams of the standings; not explained on the page.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a page of the 2019 Xi'an invitational (the copy has since been replaced); our copy now is a 2014-era notice page of the Xi'an regional, with no results of its own.
